planets.name: Kepler-11 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-11 with a 22.7-day year, found in 2010.

text.card: Kepler-11 d was found in 2010 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 6 planets known around Kepler-11. Its orbit and size follow Lissauer et al. 2013's fit, the archive's default.
